overview: Vellamo Retail Group is experiencing significant operational challenges due to 31 unowned point-to-point integrations, leading to stale inventory data, overselling, and manual order cancellations. The proposed solution is an AWS-managed integration hub designed to replace these legacy interfaces, connecting SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Service Cloud, Shopify Plus, a 3PL, and Snowflake. This platform will enable event-driven and scheduled data flows, incorporating resilience features like retries and sequence-gap detection, and will implement a daily three-way order reconciliation to improve inventory accuracy before the 2026 peak season.

customer_objectives.text: Replace 31 existing point-to-point integrations, many of which are unowned shell scripts.
Reduce overselling and manual cancellations caused by stale inventory data.

solution_highlights.text: The solution replaces 31 legacy point-to-point integrations with a centralized, managed integration hub.
The integration hub will be built on AWS using managed services, leveraging eu-north-1 and eu-west-1 regions.
It supports event-driven order and inventory flows, scheduled file exchanges, with built-in retries, dead-letter handling, sequence-gap detection, and daily three-way reconciliation.
